input.prompt: A new object from the same stadium as the floodlight tower in image[1]: a stadium press box, the commentators' booth. One long low cabin, four times as wide as tall, of dark grey riveted steel panels, with one long row of big dark tinted glass windows across the whole front leaning forward, a flat steel roof plate with corner brackets like the lamp box of image[1], on the roof a small satellite dish, two thin antennas and a row of small round floodlights, and steel lattice brackets under the floor. Perfectly left-right symmetrical. Seen from the front and a little from above and from the side. Whole object in frame, single isolated object on a plain grey background, in exactly the stylized hand-painted game prop style, weathered concrete and grey riveted steel colours and lighting of image[1]. No people, no text, no logos.
